text.tspan: The idea behind the next measure of variability is to find the ‘average distance of the data from the
mean”. The attempt to do this will not quite work in the way you expect, but it will lead to new statistics
that measure variation. Keep in mind that we will eventually use technology to perform the calculations.
This section will develop the ideas, but STAT-Utility or other technology will do the heavy computing.
Let’s take the data from Group #1 in the last example. The data values are 0, 0 ,1, 2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 10. We
have calculated that the mean is 5. We can calculate the difference between each data value and the
mean, then find the average of the differences. Great idea! The difference between a data value and the
is the difference between an observation and the mean of the data set. For a
